fields.name: id
fields.coerce: a key of `id_to_id`, so a number works as its string
fields.description: The owner of the stand that has the trade offer.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The trade slot of the offer. It must be one of the open slots of the stand now (`get_trade_slots`).

fields.name: rid
fields.coerce: compared with `!=` to the `rid` of the listing. A falsy value fails
fields.description: The `rid` of the listing. Unlike `trade_buy`, it is required: a listing that changed never matches.

fields.name: num
fields.coerce: `parseInt(num)`, so `"7"` works. NaN, a negative number or an empty slot gives `no_item`
fields.description: The slot of your item that pays for the offer.

fields.name: item
fields.coerce: compared field by field with `JSON.stringify`, except `q` (`seen_item_matches`)
fields.description: The item in slot `num` as your client last got it in `player`. Each field except `q` must have the same value, and `item` must have no field that the slot item does not have. This stops a swap with an item that changed or moved.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The owner gets your item, and you get the listed item.

fields.name: num
fields.description: Your inventory slot that got the listed item.

rows.when: No character, or you are in the bank (`player.user` is set).
No character has the name `id`, or it is an NPC, or it is invisible (condition `invis` or `ethereal`).
The owner is in the bank.
The owner is more than `B.dist` (400 px) from you, edge to edge of the two hitboxes, or on another map.
The slot of the owner is empty; or `rid` is missing or is not the `rid` of the listing; or the slot is not open now (for example, the stand is closed).
The listing is not a trade offer (no `want`), or it is a buy order (`b`) or a giveaway.
Your slot `num` is empty, or `num` is not a number.
Your item is locked (`l`) or account-bound (`acl`).
Your item has `b` (for example, it is your open stand) or `v` (it came from PvP).
`item` does not agree with your item, or your item does not satisfy the `want` of the offer (a `TradeWant`).
The inventory of the owner has no space for your item.

Your stack has more units than `want.q`, and the listed item does not fit in your inventory after `want.q` units leave the stack. When you give the whole item or the whole stack, the server does not do this check.

also.name: You
also.when: Success, first. `item` is what you gave, `received` is what you got.

example.message: Traded Staff +8 to MerchantBob for 20 Candy Pop

also.name: Owner
also.when: Success, after your `game_log`. The same phrase from the side of the owner.

example.message: Traded 20 Candy Pop to Wizard for Staff +8

also.when: Success. Every client whose view holds the owner.

fields.name: received
fields.description: Your item. For a stack, `q` is the units given.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The trade slot of the offer.

fields.name: num
fields.description: Your inventory slot that got the listed item.

fields.name: snum
fields.description: The inventory slot of the owner that got your item.

also.name: You
also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`: your item gone (or fewer units), the listed item in `items`.

also.name: Owner
also.summary: The state of the owner with `reopen: true`: your item in `items`, the trade slot empty. Clients nearby see the change in the next `entities` (`u`).

order: `player` to you, then `player` to the owner
